l1_connect_account.title: Bring every site under one management plane
l1_connect_account.why: Sites still managed from their own consoles are checked by hand, if at all, and nobody sees the estate whole.
steps: List the sites and clusters, with the tool that manages each today.
Register each site with the central management plane, read-only first.
Confirm each site reports health, capacity and alerts centrally.
l1_connect_account.success: Every site in scope reports to one management plane.
